Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Medicine MBBS at University College London

What University College London asks of applicants to Medicine MBBS for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University College London courses · Medicine field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 0 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma, UCL’s A*AA-band equivalency: 5,5 in two APs plus SAT 1470 or ACT 33 (taken in the final three years of high school) with the High School Graduation Diploma — or 5,5,5,5,4 in five APs with no SAT/ACT
  • Not confirmed for Medicine: the Medical School considers international qualifications only where the prospectus indicates them, and its list of other accepted qualifications does not include US qualifications

UCL’s 2027 equivalency data for the A*AA band (Medicine’s offer level) lists these US routes, but the Medical School’s 2027-entry page says it does not consider international qualifications unless the prospectus indicates them; its list of other accepted qualifications (European Baccalaureate, Scottish Highers, Pre-U, Irish Leaving Certificate, Singapore A-levels/NUS, HKDSE, CAPE and others) does not include US qualifications.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026UCL Medical School: 2027 entry requirements (MBBS) · UCL: 2027 international equivalency — United States (A*AA band)
English language
  • UCL English language Level 4
  • IELTS Academic: 7.5 overall with at least 7.0 in each component
  • TOEFL iBT (tests from 21 January 2026): 5.5 overall and 5.0 in each skill; earlier tests: 109 overall with 27/30 in reading and writing and 23/30 in speaking and listening
  • PTE Academic: 80 overall with at least 76 in each communicative skill
  • Not needed by nationals of UCL’s listed majority English-speaking countries (including the USA); for September 2027 entry a test must be taken on or after 1 September 2025

The Medical School’s 2027-entry page requires Level 4. Other accepted tests and qualifications (e.g. Cambridge C1/C2, GCSE/IGCSE English) are listed on UCL’s English language page; 12 months of English-taught education in an approved country (including the USA) leading to a qualification also counts. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.

Subject prerequisites
  • Required: Chemistry, Biology (A*A, either order)

Biology and Chemistry are required (A* in either); the third A-level can be any subject except General Studies or Critical Thinking. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement: accepted — see note
  • UCL’s A*AA-band US equivalency: 5,5,5,5,4 in five APs, or 5,5 in two APs plus SAT 1470/ACT 33 with the High School Graduation Diploma — not confirmed for Medicine

Official (2027 entry): the Medical School considers international qualifications only where the prospectus indicates them, and its list of other accepted qualifications does not include APs. UCL’s A*AA-band US equivalency (Medicine’s offer level) lists the AP routes shown. data/courseRequirements.js holds “Advanced Placement: accepted”, from a UCL US guidance page that now returns 404.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026UCL Medical School: 2027 entry requirements (MBBS) · UCL: 2027 international equivalency — United States (A*AA band)
Other requirements
  • Multiple mini interviews (MMIs), held between December and March
  • Reflections on work experience may be assessed at interview; a small selection of candidates may be asked for evidence of it
  • GCSE (or equivalent) English Language and Mathematics at grade B/6
  • Resits are not accepted (including restarting Year 12)
  • DBS check (Post Office ID verification about £15; the check itself is paid for by the Medical School)

Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.
